product.title: Top of the World Tour (Wildside 4x4 Tours)

description.text: Make the most of your visit to the Rocky Mountains with a photo-focussed 4x4 tour of Estes Park. In addition to capturing incredible views en route, you will learn about the history of the park, starting with the iconic 1909 Stanley Hotel. Stops include Wildside 4x4 Tours, The Stanley Hotel, Oldman Mountain, Deer Mountain, Horseshoe Falls, Old Fall River Road. Watch the surroundings change as you ascend by 12,0000 feet (3,658 metres), crossing three ecosystems, and look out for wildlife such as Moose, Elk and Deer.See the native bighorn sheep at Sheep Lake No glass windows in the tour vehicle for uninterrupted views Ideal for travelers basing in Estes Park or the Front Range who want a guided Rocky Mountain National Park outing without self-driving mountain roads.
